name: PiQuests
detailed_description:
Brains. Battles. Breakthroughs.

Your mission: Outthink, Outsolve, and Outsmart.

Welcome to a world where your sharpest weapon isn’t a sword—it’s your mind. Travel through mysterious realms, crack ancient codes, outwit quirky rivals, and face off in real-time battles where strategy matters more than speed. Every quest is packed with hidden secrets, twisted puzzles, and real risks on this enchanted island.

You'll collect rare items, unlock new areas, and level up your skills—not just in the game, but in real life. Because here’s the twist: to win, you’ll need to use the same tools real-world problem-solvers rely on—like analyzing data, spotting patterns, and thinking critically.

Designed especially for middle and high schoolers, this game-based learning adventure turns statistics into a superpower. No boring lectures. No pop quizzes. Just immersive storylines, brain-boosting gameplay, and battles that demand both logic and courage.

Whether you're playing to learn or just love a smart challenge, this game delivers strategy, storytelling, and action—all in one unforgettable quest.

Key Features

  • Combat meets critical thinking in fast-paced, real-time encounters

  • Story-based missions filled with puzzles, traps, and decision-making

  • Diverse worlds with hidden areas, collectible gear, and side quests

  • Real-world math and data skills seamlessly integrated into gameplay

  • Achievements, upgrades, and unlockable story paths that reward exploration and problem-solving

  • Virtual reality components (coming soon!)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD FX-4350 or Intel Core i5-3470 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon R7 250 or GeForce GT 640 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard onboard sound card
  • VR Support: Not required
  • Additional Notes: N/A
